Figure 11.5: Scenario: Recover by System State Change
Figure 11.5 shows the default scenario for
Recover from Supervision Failure
.
After a supervision failure has been detected by
Platform Health Management
,
Platform Health Management
notifies
State Management
by invoking the call-
back method
RecoveryHandler()
.
State Management
then determines a new
desired state (which may be the same as the current state) and requests corresponding
Function Group State
transitions from
Execution Management
.
